snippet.title: Myriad Celestia Trailer: "Anti-Destruction Alliance" | Honkai: Star Rail
snippet.description:
Citizens of the cosmos! The flames of destruction have been extinguished on Amphoreus, and the post-Irontomb era is upon us.
This is a matter of life and death. The Legion's ambitions are laid bare, and the countdown for civilization has begun.
We propose:
Guided by the Trailblaze, united with the Harmony, calculating with the Erudition, forging the shield of Preservation, and calibrating the arrows of The Hunt...
Let all intelligent life join hands, participate in the "Anti-Destruction Alliance," and defend our home!
— Interastral Peace Corporation, "Strategic Investment Department"
An invitation is sent from Astropolis to all corners of the cosmos, as the full moon rises once again over Planarcadia.
Before the conspiracy of mortals has even begun, the game of the gods has already commenced...

English Voice:
Pearl — Cat Protano
Opal — Paul Castro Jr.
Jingliu — AmaLee
Yao Guang — Ari Thrash
Ruan Mei — Emi Lo
Boothill — Andrew Russell
Rappa — Kendell Byrd
Ashveil — Blythe Melin

Sparxie — Lizzie Freeman
Blade — Daman Mills
Kafka — Cheryl Texiera
